top_paper.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation without Any Supervision
top_paper.summary: Unsupervised on-policy self-distillation improves large language models by using internal consistency and majority-vote pseudo-solutions to correct confident errors without external supervision.

papers.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
papers.summary: CoinRAG improves retrieval-augmented generation efficiency and accuracy by reusing fine-grained semantic nugget caches instead of full chunks.

papers.title: InSight-doc: Agentic Visual Perception for Long-Document Understanding
papers.summary: InSight-doc adaptively allocates visual resolution during reasoning to improve long-document understanding while reducing latency and hallucinations.

papers.title: Power law graph attention: exact generalization of scaled dot-product attention, empirical collapse at inference
papers.summary: A new attention mechanism replaces fixed scaled dot-product attention with a learned power-law bilinear operator, with verified architecture, measured stability, and machine-checked proofs.

papers.title: 360CityArena: A Realistic Virtual Urban Navigation Benchmark for Embodied Agents
papers.summary: A new photorealistic urban benchmark reveals large performance gaps for embodied agents in city-scale navigation and spatial reasoning.

papers.title: Decoding-Level Taboo: A Diagnostic Stress Test for LLM Robustness
papers.summary: Decoding-Level Taboo is a runtime logit-space stress test that reveals how large language models handle off-nominal generation paths, showing that robustness depends on scale and instruction alignment.

papers.title: UniMoMo: Expert Merging-Based MoE Acceleration for Large Recommendation Models
papers.summary: UniMoMo compresses trained recommendation mixture-of-experts models into smaller standard MoE checkpoints via functional similarity grouping and layer-adaptive protection, preserving accuracy while accelerating inference.

papers.title: Articulated Object Reconstruction from Rest-State Observation
papers.summary: A rest-state framework reconstructs articulated objects from a single closed configuration by fusing vision-language outputs into consistent part meshes and validating synthesized motion hypotheses via geometric consistency.

papers.title: DistilVDR: A Compact End-to-End Visual Document Retriever via Dual-Student Distillation
papers.summary: DistilVDR is a compact 524M vision-document retriever distilled from an 8B teacher using cosine alignment without relevance labels, achieving near-teacher accuracy with far smaller indexes and faster indexing.

papers.title: AdvFD: Boosting Visual Generation via Adversarial Fr'echet Distance Loss
papers.summary: Adversarial Fréchet Distance improves generator post-training by adding a learnable adversarial feature space to static Fréchet losses, with whitening to stabilize optimization.

papers.title: Not Worth Another Token: Marginal Value Estimation for Efficient Deep Research Agents
papers.summary: Pruning strategies applied at different pipeline stages reduce token usage and latency in long-horizon research agents, with early pruning yielding the greatest efficiency gains.

papers.title: Reference-Free Post-Training of Open Large Language Models for Multilingual Machine Translation
papers.summary: Open multilingual translation models are improved via group relative policy optimization with reference-free quality rewards and checkpoint interpolation, surpassing strong open and proprietary baselines.

papers.title: ComBodied Agents: a New Paradigm of Human-Centric Agentic AI
papers.summary: Combodied Agents integrate digital and embodied tools into a closed-loop framework that models individual human-state trajectories over time to provide proportionate, consent-aware support.

papers.title: iFAN: Inference-Aware Learning for Plain Mask Transformers
papers.summary: A training framework called iFAN improves mask transformers by aligning query ranking with mask quality and distilling stronger intermediate predictions to the final layer.

papers.title: TSDS-Toolbox: A Toolbox for Measuring Time-Series Dataset Similarity
papers.summary: A unified toolbox enables reproducible comparison and extension of time-series dataset similarity methods for forecasting, classification, and generation tasks.

papers.title: JigShape: Evaluating Visual-Geometric Reasoning in VLMs through Jigsaw Puzzles
papers.summary: A new jigsaw benchmark with interlocking pieces reveals that vision-language models fail at geometric reasoning and suffer a sharp performance drop as puzzle size increases.

papers.title: Ex-Omni-2D: Expressive Omni-Modal Dialogue Models with Native Visual Presence
papers.summary: Ex-Omni-2D is an omni-modal dialogue framework that produces coordinated text, speech, and video responses via a visual thought plan and a distilled streaming video generator.

papers.title: SkillZip: Evaluation-Free Skill Compression for Self-Evolving Agents by Discovering Reusable Structure
papers.summary: SkillZip compresses self-evolving agent skills by finding a minimal faithful structural explanation that shares repeated rules and procedures while preserving rare exceptions, without requiring evaluation rollouts.

papers.title: Co-Evolution in Agentic Systems: Toward Self-Directed Evolution Beyond Human Design
papers.summary: Agentic systems can achieve open-ended improvement through multi-component co-evolution that progressively removes fixed human constraints across agents, environments, and evolution mechanisms.

papers.title: DSAgentBench: Can Agents Automate End-to-End Data-Science Workflows in Real Computer Environments?
papers.summary: DSAgentBench evaluates autonomous agents on complete, multi-tool data-science workflows in real computing environments and reveals major performance gaps.

papers.title: SPIEval: Evaluating Large Language Models as Mobile Assistants over Scattered Personal Information
papers.summary: SPIEval benchmarks mobile assistant LLMs on scattered personal data tasks, revealing major gaps in information retrieval and verification.

papers.title: VibeLifeBench: Can Your Life Agent Be Proactive and Persistent in a Living World?
papers.summary: A new benchmark called VibeLifeBench evaluates long-horizon proactive agents across simulated multi-week everyday tasks, revealing that current frontier models perform poorly.

papers.title: Mendel Gödel Machine: Recursive Self-Improving Coding Agents via Comparative Evolution
papers.summary: Mendel Gödel Machine improves self-improving coding agents by using multi-trajectory mutations and cross-lineage hybridization to accelerate convergence and boost performance.

papers.title: Beyond Pixels: From Video Priors to 4D Worlds
papers.summary: Latent-to-4D enables reusable direct 4D generation from video diffusion latents via alignment with a pretrained decoder and spatiotemporal attention, transferring across generators without retraining.

papers.title: VectraYX-Vision-1B: A Sub-2B Spanish/LATAM Cybersecurity Vision-Language Model with Structured Visual Reasoning and Native Tool Use
papers.summary: A sub-2B Spanish cybersecurity vision-language model couples a frozen SigLIP encoder to a Spanish decoder via an MLP, introduces a NoPE positional-encoding ablation for visual attention, and reports near-zero visual grounding despite functional pipelines, with open-source weights and remediation plans.

papers.title: The Next Screenshot Knows: Gated Hindsight Distillation for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.summary: Gated Hindsight Distillation improves GUI agent training by using future screenshots as privileged evidence to recover correct reasoning when standard imitation fails.

papers.title: Beyond Sequence Order: Syntax-Informed Positional Embeddings for Transformers
papers.summary: SiPE integrates a lightweight syntactic prior from dependency parses into positional embeddings across transformer architectures, improving syntactic generalization and language understanding without altering self-attention or increasing inference cost.

papers.title: Beyond Starry Night: Shortcut-Aware Control-State Planning for Artist-Grounded Text to Image Generation
papers.summary: Atelier improves artist-grounded image generation by translating vague artistic intent into explicit control states that separate scene content from style, reducing reliance on stereotypical shortcuts.

papers.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation without Any Supervision
papers.summary: Unsupervised on-policy self-distillation improves large language models by using internal consistency and majority-vote pseudo-solutions to correct confident errors without external supervision.

papers.title: Cultivar: A Contrastive and Locale-Oriented Translation Benchmark for Investigating Contamination and Localisation Robustness
papers.summary: Researchers propose source-contrastive evaluation via a localized benchmark to detect data contamination and assess localization robustness in multilingual translation models.

papers.title: Business Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents in a Realistic Marketplace
papers.summary: Business Arena evaluates LLM agents running a realistic cross-border shop, revealing large performance gaps versus human strategies and enabling detailed attribution of business decisions.
